title: Harold D Probable NDE 22840
content: I was really badly sick with the flu and I laid down on the couch , and I remember thinking I never felt this bad , so I laid there a few minutes with my eyes closed because I felt so bad. Then suddenly I thought I feel pretty good and when I opened my eyes I was hovering above my body but I wasn't scared. The next thing I know I'm floating in a big tunnel. If I had to guess, maybe 25-30 ft. in diameter the walls were black and there were shiny black rocks of different sizes. I floated for a few seconds and I could see a light at the far end. The tunnel was cone-shaped. Then all of a sudden, I was sucked to the light and I came out on the other side. I saw it was a clear sky with a few little clouds and there was rolling hills really beautiful and the grass was a little below my knee, maybe 7 or 8 inches high. There was also a small creek winding down from the hills. Then I noticed a group of people across the creek. They were older people, all dressed in white. I didn't know any of them. Now here's the kicker. My wife had died 2 yrs. earlier and she came from around the back of them. She came to me. I was standing at the edge of the creek. She walks to the other side of the creek up to the edge and then tells me, ‘It's not my time. You have to go back.’ I told her I want to stay with her. Then she says, ‘Harold you have to go back, it's not your time.’ She told me we would be together again. Then it felt like I was being sucked back, like I was dropped into my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Bad Flu Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Darkness | Light | A landscape or city | Boundary
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was aware and very alert.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning No idea how long it lasted.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Popping noises and that a fast, sucking sound.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I met my wife. We talked.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A bright light at the end of a tunnel.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It's hard to explain.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you reach a boundary or limiting phy: Uncertain I believe the creek was the boundary.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told I had to go back.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I was told I had to go back. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best was being at peace and seeing my wife. The worst was going back.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I have told several close friends.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: No, not that I can think of at the moment.
